query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Create multimedia travel marketing assets from scripts and stock/generative media, then deliver generated files by email and provide downloadable presentation content.
query_ground_truth.query: email these documents to my contact
query_ground_truth.rationale: The final generated multimedia assets need to be delivered to the client via email.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm recipient address(es), subject, non-empty body, whether body is HTML, and any attachments; choose provider using GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL or OUTLOOK_SEND_EMAIL (prepare correct send inputs).
[Optional (if recipient address is unknown/ambiguous)] [Prerequisite]: Resolve and confirm the intended recipient using GMAIL_SEARCH_PEOPLE (avoid misdelivery from similar matches).
[Required] [Step]: Send the message using GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL or OUTLOOK_SEND_EMAIL (ensure HTML flag matches body format).
[Optional (if review/approval is needed before delivery)] [Step]: Create a draft using GMAIL_CREATE_EMAIL_DRAFT or OUTLOOK_CREATE_DRAFT (stage for edits/approval).
[Optional (if a draft was approved)] [Next Step]: Send the approved draft using GMAIL_SEND_DRAFT or OUTLOOK_SEND_DRAFT (finalize delivery).
[Optional (if the first provider send fails or is unavailable)] [Fallback]: Retry delivery by switching providers using OUTLOOK_SEND_EMAIL or GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL (recover from provider-specific issues).
known_pitfalls: [GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL] Using recipient_email="me" targets the authenticated mailbox; set an explicit external address when emailing someone else.
[GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL] Sending can fail if the Gmail connection is inactive/unavailable; use OUTLOOK_SEND_EMAIL when Gmail is not connected.
[GMAIL_SEARCH_PEOPLE] Queries can return multiple similar matches; confirm the selected result before sending.
[GMAIL_CREATE_EMAIL_DRAFT] Persist the returned draft identifier so it can be passed to GMAIL_SEND_DRAFT.
[OUTLOOK_SEND_EMAIL] A successful send may return status_code=202 with data.body=null/empty; treat this as accepted-by-API rather than expecting a message object.

OUTLOOK_SEND_EMAIL.description: Sends an email with subject, body, recipients, and optional attachments via Microsoft Graph API. Supports comma-separated email addresses in the to_email field for multiple recipients. Accepts either a single file or a list of files as attachments. Attachments require a non-empty file with valid name and mimetype.

GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL.description: Sends an email via Gmail API using the authenticated user's Google profile display name. Sends immediately and is irreversible — confirm recipients, subject, body, and attachments before calling. At least one of 'to' (or 'recipient_email'), 'cc', or 'bcc' must be provided. At least one of subject or body must be provided. Requires `is_html=True` if the body contains HTML. All common file types including PNG, JPG, PDF, MP4, etc. are supported as attachments. Gmail API limits total message size to ~25 MB after base64 encoding. To reply in an existing thread, use GMAIL_REPLY_TO_THREAD instead. No scheduled send support; enforce timing externally.

cc.description: Carbon Copy (CC) recipients' email addresses. At least one of 'to'/'recipient_email', 'cc', or 'bcc' must be provided.

bcc.description: Blind Carbon Copy (BCC) recipients' email addresses. At least one of 'to'/'recipient_email', 'cc', or 'bcc' must be provided.

examples: Hello team, let's discuss the project updates tomorrow.

from_email.description: Sender email address for the 'From' header. Use this to send from a verified alias configured in Gmail's 'Send mail as' settings. When not provided, the authenticated user's primary email address is used. The alias must be verified in Gmail settings before use.

recipient_email.description: Primary recipient's email address. You can also use 'to' as an alias for this parameter. At least one of 'to'/'recipient_email', 'cc', or 'bcc' must be provided. Use extra_recipients if you want to send to multiple recipients. Use the special value 'me' to send to your own authenticated email address. Must be a full user@domain address; 'me' is not valid here and will fail.

extra_recipients.description: Additional 'To' recipients' email addresses (not Cc or Bcc). Should only be used if recipient_email is also provided.
